title: Commonwealth Air Crews
memorial_details: Two propeller blades from a Bristol Beaufighter plane mounted on brick and concrete plinth. Dedicatory plaque with raised inscription on stand above plinth. Brushed stainless steel plaque in wood frame with names was added in 2009 on stand in front of plinth.
inscription: Top plaque: THIS MEMORIAL WAS ERECTED BY/ THE STRATFORD ON AVON AVIATION/ AND MILITARIA ENTHUSIASTS TO/ THE MEMORY OF THE TWO/ COMMONWEALTH AIR CREWS WHO/ DIED ON THIS STRETCH OF RIVER/ 1942 AND 1943/ LEST WE FORGET Bottom plaque, centre: THE TWO COMMONWEALTH AIRCREWS Bottom plaque, left column: DIED 25th AUGUST 1942/ (Names) Bottom plaque, right column: DIED 23rd JULY 1943/ (Names)
custodian: c2009-present: A residents' group in Wasperton and Hampton Lucy with permission of Birmington Anglers Association Ltd, which owns the land c1976-c2009: Wellesbourne Airfield Museum
